phone.notes: The description box of a Digimon keeps its size and scrolls when the text is longer. Descriptions of almost every Digimon are now available (they download when the app opens or from Settings). Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Wild Digimon now appear after a few hundred steps, not a few dozen: each step has a 0.1% chance, and steps taken while asleep or during a pending meeting no longer count.
